mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% is associated with negative 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 0.5% is associated with positive 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in federal funds rate and unemployment rate (both > 0.3pp change in 3 months) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion (HOUST > 1600 thousand units), strong consumer demand supports economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1600 is associated with negative 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher employment levels (PAYEMS) signal a strong labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS level is associated with negative 5-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in annual inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annual change above 2.5% is associated with positive 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise and industrial production (INDPRO) falls (HOUST > 0.3pp change, INDPRO < -0.3pp change in 3 months), it signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising HOUST and falling INDPRO does not produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 105.0), weakening economic activity reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 105.0 is associated with positive 5-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
